name: Issho ni Shitai o Umete
source:
Umi, calm and level-headed. Sora, optimistic and cheerful.
What would you do if a friend asked you to help them bury a body...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11988]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
乌米，冷静而冷静。索拉，乐观开朗。
如果一个朋友请你帮助他们埋葬尸体，你会怎么做？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11988]Novelgame[/url]]
